sloka: यद्यपि त्वम् क्षितितलाद्गगनम् चोत्पतिष्यसि ।पितुर्व्म्शचरित्रज्ञः सोऽन्यथा न करिष्यति ॥२-३७-३१॥
transliteration: yadyapi tvam kṣititalādgaganam cotpatiṣyasi ।piturvmśacaritrajñaḥ so'nyathā na kariṣyati ॥2-37-31॥

translations.english: Even if you were to fly from earth to sky, Bharata who knows the traditions of his father's dynasty, will not act otherwise.
